question: Should buffer-verified APK packages be allowed as host-local outbound attachments when tools.fs.workspaceOnly is false?
rationale: This intentionally expands the host-file exfiltration boundary to an installable executable package type; tests can prove classification but cannot choose that product-security policy.

options.title: Allow verified APKs
options.body: Accept APKs only when the buffer contains canonical Android package evidence, and require the classifier/gate regression fix before merge.

options.title: Keep APKs blocked
options.body: Decline the boundary expansion and close or pause this PR while retaining the existing archive and safe-document policy.

recommendation.title: Allow verified APKs
recommendation.body: Accept APKs only when the buffer contains canonical Android package evidence, and require the classifier/gate regression fix before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal spans the host-read gate, media classifier, outbound tests, and attachment documentation.
